newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Niaga signs US$40 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bank Niaga signs US$40 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Niaga signed a US$40 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue in Hong Kong on Friday, the arrangers said.
The five-year issue, which was launched through the borrower's Cayman Islands branch, has put and call options at the end of the third and fourth year.
The certificates were issued at par to float at 70 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate for the first three years and 50 basis points over LIBOR thereafter.
Fees are 51 basis points for co-lead managers and 48 basis points for managers.
Arrangers and lead managers are Bayerische Landesbank's Singapore branch and Sumitomo Finance (Asia).
Co-arrangers and lead managers are United Overseas Bank and Yasuda Trust Europe.
Co-lead managers are First National Bank of Chicago, Merita Bank's Singapore branch and Bank Austria's Singapore branch.

Managers are Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait BSC, Bank of Commerce (L), Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale, Banca di Roma's Hongkong branch, Bank Brussels Lambert's Singapore branch, Landesbank Saar Girozentrale and National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
